g.text: 2 IN / 2 OUT MIDI DAUGHTERBOARD - ENGINEERING DRAFT
Original Raspberry Pi Zero | 9 V centre-negative | TRS Type A | no PCB layout or ERC sign-off
POWER: insulated jack; one power source only
5.01 V nominal; feedback tolerance reviewed in README.
No USB/pedal dual powering. Validate startup and ripple before attaching Pi.
ISOLATED INPUTS: sleeves unconnected; preserve LED-side isolation
LED on = RX low. No breath/controller-specific hardware filtering.
OUTPUTS: 5 V current loops; 3.3 V noninverting open-drain driver
UART GPIO pulldowns (unused pins): do not enable modem/GPIO outputs
DRAFT: footprints intentionally unassigned. Independently review, open in KiCad and run ERC before PCB design.
